DATED: 11/06/2024  u  IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/CRIMINAL MISC.APPLICATION (FOR SUCCESSIVE REGULAR BAIL -  AFTER CHARGESHEET) NO. 9198 of 2024 ==========================================================
 FARAZALI MOHAMMADSALIM SHAIKH  Versus  STATE OF GUJARAT ==========================================================
Appearance:
MR RAZIN S ZEENA FOR O I PATHAN(7684) for the Applicant(s) No. 1 MS MONALI H BHATT, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1 ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE DIVYESH A. JOSHI  Date : 11/06/2024  ORAL ORDER 1. Rule returnable forthwith.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned APP waives service of notice of rule for and on behalf of the respondent-State.

2. The present application is filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, for regular bail in connection with the FIR being C.R. No.11196027230487 of 2023 registered with the Karelibaug Police Station, Vadodara, for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code and under Sections-4, 6, 8, 10, 12 of The Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Learned advocate appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that the present successive bail application is preferred by the applicant after recording of the deposition of NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/9198/2024 ORDER DATED: 11/06/2024 undefined the complainant as well as the victim.

He further submits that earlier after submission of charge-sheet, the bail application was Farazali Mohammadsalim Shaikh vs State Of Gujarat on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172656383/
1 preferred, which was withdrawn with a liberty to approach this Court after recording of the deposition of the complainant as well as the victim.

entities.text: Farazali Mohammadsalim Shaikh vs State Of Gujarat on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submitted that the present applicant - accused was arrested on 17.11.2023 and since then he is in jail.
He further submits that the complainant as well as the victim were examined by the prosecution and they have not supported the case of the prosecution and they have turned hostile.
Considering the above-stated factual aspect as well as role attributed to the applicant-accused, the applicant may be enlarged on bail on any suitable terms and conditions.
4. The learned APP appearing on behalf of the respondent- State has opposed grant of regular bail looking to the nature and gravity of the offence.
It is submitted that the specific role of the present applicant is clearly spelt out from the papers of charge-sheet.

Learned APP has submitted that considering the role attributed to the applicant-accused, this is a fit case wherein discretionary power of this Court is not required to be exercised in favour of the applicant-accused.
5. The learned advocates appearing on behalf of the respective parties do not press for further reasoned order.

6. I have heard the learned advocates appearing on behalf of the respective parties and perused the papers of the investigation and considered the allegations levelled against the applicant and the role played by the applicant.

This Court has also taken into consideration the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Sanjay Chandra v. Central Bureau of Investigation, reported in [2012]1 SCC 40.
8.

entities.text: Sanjay Chandra v. Central Bureau of Investigation, reported in [2012]1 SCC 40
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the facts and circumstances of the case and considering the nature of the allegations made against the applicant in the FIR, without discussing the evidence in detail, prima facie, this Court is of the opinion that this is a fit case to exercise the discretion and enlarge the applicant on regular bail.

entities.text: Farazali Mohammadsalim Shaikh vs State Of Gujarat on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The authorities will release the applicant only if he is not required in connection with any other offence for the time being.
If breach of any of the above conditions is committed, the Sessions Judge concerned will be free to issue warrant or take appropriate action in the matter.
11. Bail bond to be executed before the lower Court having jurisdiction to try the case.
It will be open for the concerned Court to delete, modify and/or relax any of the above conditions, in accordance with law.

At the trial, the trial Court shall not be influenced by the observations of preliminary nature qua the evidence at this stage made by this Court while NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/9198/2024 ORDER DATED: 11/06/2024 undefined enlarging the applicant on bail.
Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
Direct service is permitted.
